bio:
Into the depths of fantasy w/ Komomo

*Monthly*

Ignacio Marti, aka Komomo, is a Barcelona-based artist who considers himself an eternal internet rat, which has allowed him to connect with networks of people and styles outside the mainstream. His mixes usual blend ambient and trance, moving through hyperpop and sextrance to noise and hard techno, and has made sets for NTS and his bestie @trixy tricks' Madrid-based INSULT0 club. For the past few months, he has been uploading to yt a mix compilation influenced by nature called VISIONS. He also dedicates time to analyze online hate speech and the manosphere, and uses sculpture alongside music to heal and express his inner world.
title: Komomo
